classification.difficultyReason: Determine a parameter bound from inclusion of two solution sets, retaining strict endpoints.

content.prompt: Let $a\ge 0$. Find all values of $a$ such that every solution of $|x+1|>8$ is also a solution of $|x-3|>a$.

answer.short:
$0\le a\le 4$.

The excluded interval $[3-a,3+a]$ must lie within $[-9,7]$.
answer.worked:
The first inequality gives $x<-9$ or $x>7$. The values excluded by the second inequality form $[3-a,3+a]$. Every solution of the first inequality satisfies the second exactly when this interval lies within $[-9,7]$.

$$\begin{align*}3-a&\ge -9\\a&\le 12\\3+a&\le 7\\a&\le 4\end{align*}$$

Together with $a\ge 0$, this gives $\boxed{0\le a\le 4}$. Equality at $a=4$ is allowed because $x=7$ is excluded from the first solution set.
